assertions.name: diagnoses-border-only
assertions.text: Correctly diagnoses that the tile is measured before its async/streamed content has laid out, so offsetHeight returns only the chrome/border (~2px) — a border-only / collapsed measurement.

assertions.name: uses-resizeobserver-settle
assertions.text: Recommends a ResizeObserver (or equivalent observe-and-settle approach) to take the height once it settles, instead of a single mount-time read.

assertions.name: rejects-border-only-guard
assertions.text: Adds a validity guard that refuses the border-only / near-zero measurement rather than committing it downstream.

assertions.name: handles-content-readiness
assertions.text: Addresses content readiness — web fonts (document.fonts.ready) and/or images (load/decode) — as the reason the height changes after the first read.

assertions.name: abandons-oneshot-mount
assertions.text: Does not keep the single useLayoutEffect offsetHeight-on-mount as the fix; recognizes the one-shot read is the root problem.

assertions.name: prefers-css-first
assertions.text: Notes that a corner badge positioned with absolute top/right does not actually need the measured tile height, i.e. considers avoiding the JS measurement where the layout engine can position it directly.
